mapper.select: select * from contacts where user_id = #{userId} and id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into contacts(user_id, name, phone, landline) values(#{userId},#{name},#{phone},#{landline})
mapper.update: update contacts set name=#{name},phone=#{phone},landline=#{landline} where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from contacts where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
